items.title: MacBook Air reportedly facing major supply shortages due to AI-driven memory crisis
items.raw_content: The AI datacenter buildout around the US has wreaked havoc across the entire consumer electronics industry. All of this newly found high volume purchasing of high end HBM2 DRAM has shifted entire supply chains, making it incredibly difficult to come across consumer grade memory and storage. SSDs and DDR5 RAM have shot up in price since the start of the year, and Apple finally had to adjust its pricing in late June – with everything becoming $100-400+ more across the board. Despite those price hikes, the company is still struggling to keep MacBook Air in stock.
items.title_zh: AI驱动存储危机导致MacBook Air严重供应短缺
items.summary: US AI datacenter buildout has shifted HBM2 DRAM supply chains, driving consumer SSD and DDR5 RAM prices up $100-400+ across Apple's lineup while MacBook Air stock runs low despite price hikes.
